name: rest
effect: key off now, set bit4 (suppress next key-on), end the parse: the note length still elapses

name: volume n
effect: $2200,x = n (x 11-13: n*8), re-apply TL / SSG volume ($EA49)

name: legato
effect: set bit3 of $2400,x: the gate-time key-off of the next note is skipped

name: patch ptr lo hi
effect: YM2203 channels 8-10: write inline FM patch (operator regs $30-$9f, FB/ALG) from the pointer via $F53B; YM2151 channels ignore it but the 2 bytes are consumed

name: repeat n
effect: push (return pointer, n) on the channel stack ($2400 page, ptr $11/$12 from $E2E2/$E2F2)

name: end repeat
effect: decrement the top count; loop back to the pointer or pop

name: FM TL add
effect: YM2203 FM / SSG: add to a carrier operator TL (op, value) (x 11+: value only); YM2151 channels return without reading

name: key on
effect: key on now ($EC31): YM2151 reg $08 / YM2203 reg $28

name: END
effect: end of channel: key off, $2400,x = 0, slot count -1; the last channel of a slot frees the slot ($2310,slot = 0)

name: CH3 op freq +16 (op,n)
effect: YM2203 channel 3 special mode: 16-bit add to operator freq $2426/$2422,op, rewrite regs $A8-$AE ($EF31)

name: CH3 op freq hi + (op,n)
effect: add to the high byte only

name: CH3 op freq set (op,lo,hi)
effect: set the operator frequency, rewrite regs

name: volume slide n
effect: $2270,x = n ? ~n : 0 (target-seeking volume step in $E8BE every 4th IRQ2)

name: LFO sync on
effect: $2470,x bit7: YM2151 reg $01 test bit pulse at every key-on

name: OKI continue
effect: channels 14/15: $60 = 1 so the parser continues after an OKI note trigger

name: OKI2 start n
effect: table entry n of the OKI2 table ($F651 with $53=1)

name: OKI1 start n
effect: table entry n of table A ($F651 with $53=0)

name: CT=$c0
effect: YM2151 reg $1b: $62 |= $c0, selects OKI2 table C (identity table)

name: load patch n
effect: YM2151 (x<8): load FM patch n from the patch bank (bank 6 loader $4203, data in banks 7+); YM2203: $4200

name: clock param n
effect: $72 = n (read only by the clock code $FDD9)

name: $2738 n
effect: $2738,x = n (read only by FD50/FD77: output to the unread ring $2798)
